coordinateSystem: Y up; original SM64 coordinates divided by 100. Yaw is degrees from +Z toward +X.
routeDescription: Grounded original Koopa route, prefixed by start approach and ending near boss. The route includes the first bridge and Chomp bend, then a deliberate drop to low ground by the seesaw; it does not use the seesaw, which remains available as a free-roam route. Not an invisible rail or level geometry.

routeActions.reason: Gap across the lower mountain trail; original Koopa route traverses this gap.
